summary: Frontend-only test of Blue Light Phase 4 (Auto Certificate) operator UI on contract CTR-BLFRS1. Verified: Certificates toggle + panel, 4 status count tiles, certificate rows (station + filename + status pill), PDF download (valid %PDF, 121KB), Approve & send on an awaiting_review certificate (alert 'Certificate sent to fleet.fitness@example-frs.gov.uk.', row pill flipped Awaiting review -> Sent, tiles refreshed 1/1 -> 2/0, contract CERTIFICATES tile 1/82 -> 2/82), the per-contract bl-cfg-logo field (saved + persisted as blue_light.customer_logo_url), and the visit wizard visit-completed screen download-cert-btn (valid 124KB PDF). All 5 requested items PASS.

issues: Status pills ('Sent' light green, 'Awaiting review' amber) are 11px on a white surface — contrast is borderline for AA small text; consider darker pill text or a tinted background chip.
Certificate list is a flat unpaginated list — with up to 82 stations this panel will grow very long; consider status filter/pagination.

action_items: Optional polish only: darken certificate status pill text and add a status filter/pagination to the certificates list once the count grows.

Informational: visits completed BEFORE Phase 4 (e.g. Appledore, Axminster) had certificate_status 'outstanding' with no certificate row; there is no back-fill path in the UI (only POST /visits/{id}/certificate/generate). Consider a 'Generate certificate' action for completed visits without a certificate.
Pre-existing/unrelated: the /crm page fires several 401s and shows a 'Your session has expired' toast when only crm_token is present (no platform token). Not blocking the Blue Light tab but noisy.
critical_code_review_comments: BlueLightTab.downloadCert / VisitWizard download-cert-btn call URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href) synchronously right after a.click(); it worked in Chromium here but can abort the save in some browsers — revoke in a setTimeout(...,0) instead.

downloadCert/approveCert use window.alert for both success and error; a toast with the recipient list would match the rest of the CRM UI. Wizard download-cert-btn swallows errors with .catch(() => {}) — no user feedback on failure.
Certificate PDF generation is resilient to an unreachable customer_logo_url (verified: generation returned 200 with a fake https://example.com/crest-test.png logo) — good.
seed_data_creation: Used POST /crm/v2/visits/{id}/certificate/generate to create awaiting_review certificates for the already-completed Appledore visit (30405126-…, then approved via UI -> now 'sent') and Axminster visit (b52c1474-… -> still 'awaiting_review', left in place as test data). No seed data deleted. blue_light.customer_logo_url was set to a test URL by the UI test and then reset to empty via API.
test_credentials: CRM: owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! via POST /api/crm/auth/login; store token in localStorage 'crm_token' + crm_active_mode='business'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Contract b113a3cd-9998-434b-8bc4-a02e417eef91 (CTR-BLFRS1) now has 3 certificates: Bruton (sent), Appledore (sent, approved via UI in this run), Axminster (awaiting_review — use this one to re-test Approve & send; regenerate via POST /crm/v2/visits/{completed_visit_id}/certificate/generate if you need another). Resend really sends to fleet.fitness@example-frs.gov.uk. customer_logo_url is currently empty.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. Initial absence of an awaiting_review certificate was seed state, resolved by regenerating certificates for two already-completed visits.
